name: billee
description: Billing SaaS platform for businesses, freelancers, and influencers

scripts.build: cd client && npm run build && cd ../server && npm run build
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.db:push: cd server && npx prisma db push
scripts.deploy: npm run install:all && npm run db:generate && npm run db:push && npm run build && echo 'Deploy ready! Run: npm start'
